content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident detected — elevated OOM/CUDA errors on pool-rt-08 (us-west-2). 3 container restarts in 2m. Auto-escalating to incidents. https://internal.incidents/1768504321

alex.sre: Ack. I'm on it. Seeing containers restart with CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY and kernel OOM killer logs. Node flapped (reboot) twice. Attaching snippet:

alex.sre: ```kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 3245 (redwood-runtime) score 123 or sacrifice child
runtime: CudaError: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY at cuLaunchKernel
``` 

priya.oncall: oncall priya — paging runtime and eng-runtime. Initial triage: isolate traffic from pool-rt-08, scale up warm pool, set eviction to aggressive. Paging looks correlated with kvcache fragmentation; likely slow creep causing slab exhaustion. I will page runtime lead @sam.runtime :wrench:

sam.runtime: I see the same. kvcache stats show lots of stale pages and fragmented free bitmap. Slow leak over 3 days, then tail triggered OOM during long chat sessions. Paste topo:

sam.runtime: ```
KVCache: total_pages=1_024_000 used=912_340 free_frag=9.3% largest_free_chunk=2_048
PagedAllocator: page_count=128k fragmented_slots=42k avg_slot_unused=16
``` 

carla.support: Customer impact — two customers (cust-945, cust-1123) reported 503s on long-running chat sessions; some messages lost and retries showed increased latency. CS has opened escalations and sent an interim note.

ops-bot: Autoscaler: added 2 nodes to pool-rt-08 at 1768504360 but health checks failing; new nodes also showing high GPU mem reservations and flapped.

maya.eng: Proposed immediate mitigations:
- Patch runtime to enable KV defrag (fast path) and reduce page_max_age to 30s
- Toggle attention paging off for model-family 'redwood-llm-13b' on affected nodes
- Set eviction.policy=eager for kvcache
- Rolling restart canary 1 node -> monitor

alex.sre: Running canary now. kubectl commands:

alex.sre: ```bash
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/runtime-pool-rt-08 --grace-period=30
kubectl -n inference patch deploy/runtime-pool-rt-08 -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"kv-defrag":"true","kv-evict":"eager"}}}}}'
``` 

priya.oncall: Shifting 50% of traffic to warm-pool-usw2 at 1768504405 and enabling fallback route to redwood-llm-7b-quant for heavy sessions. :thumbsup:

sam.runtime: Deployed allocator patch (reduce page_max_age) to canary node at 1768504440. Observing background compaction running; freed ~4GB after 60s. Logs:

sam.runtime: ```
[alloc] compaction: freed 4.1GB pages in 62s, fragmentation->5.1%
``` 

carla.support: Notifying customers: status page updated (https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1768504321). Sending follow-up to cust-945 and cust-1123 with temporary mitigations.

ops-bot: Health checks stable on canary node after patch. New nodes still flaky; holding further scale-up.

maya.eng: Recommend hotfix rollout: kv-defrag flag + eager eviction + disable attention-paging on affected model family. Plan: canary -> 10% -> full. Rollout window 15m, rollback on >1% error.

priya.oncall: Proceeding with 10% rollout at 1768504580. Monitoring p50/p95/p99 for latency and 503 rates. Alert thresholds lowered.

alex.sre: After 10% rollout we saw 503 rate drop 60% and GPU mem pressure decreased. Preparing full rollout. :raised_hands:

sam.runtime: Note: long-term fix tracked in ENG-4219 to add periodic compaction and better free-bitmap coalescing. Backport plan for 1.4.x.

carla.support: Customer update: both escalations acknowledged, CS will follow-up post-incident with root-cause and mitigation steps. 

priya.oncall: Declaring Sev2 for now. Stabilizing. Handoff in 20m to alex.sre for post-incident cleanup and RCA. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident severity updated to Sev2 at 1768504700. Timeline updated. https://internal.incidents/1768504321/timeline

alex.sre: Handoff: I'll own the post-mortem and cleanup. Actions assigned:
- ENG-4219 implement allocator compaction (sam.runtime)
- HOTFIX-178 deploy kv-defrag to all pools (maya.eng)
- SUPPORT-331 customer comms (carla.support)

priya.oncall: Thanks team — staying available for any regressions. :bow:

carla.support: Closing live mitigation channel; moving discussion to #postmortems/1768504321 for RCA notes.

incident-bot: Incident resolved for live user impact at 1768504921 — traffic restored and metrics stable for 10m. :tada:
